title: Audit Before You Merge: Provenance, Probing, and Continual LoRA Composition
abstract: arXiv:2611.10684v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Post-hoc merging of public LoRA adapters is an attractive gradient-free path to continual adaptation, but reliable measurement of catastrophic forgetting in this setting depends on infrastructure that prior work has not addressed. We treat each adapter merge as a sequential task in a continual-learning setting, with the instruction-tuned base model's capabilities as Task 0, and study forgetting on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Public adapter hubs contain modules that fail basic provenance checks: silent base-version mismatches and near-zero delta norms whose inclusion inflates measured interference by ~10pp. We propose a two-check audit (base-model match, non-trivial delta norm) and a leakage-free probing protocol as preconditions for any forgetting study in this setting. On an audited 4-adapter set, naive merging causes -10.5pp on GSM8K and -18.3pp on HumanEval, while Task Arithmetic at lambda=0.5 sits within a standard error of the unmerg

translated_title: 合并之前先审计：来源溯源、探测与持续 LoRA 组合
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.10684v2 公告类型：替换。摘要：对公开 LoRA 适配器进行事后合并是一条无需梯度的有吸引力的持续适应路径，但在该设置下对灾难性遗忘的可靠测量依赖于此前工作尚未解决的基础设施。我们将每次适配器合并视为持续学习设置中的一个顺序任务，将指令微调基础模型的能力视为任务 0，并在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上研究遗忘现象。公开适配器库中包含无法通过基本来源检查的模块：隐式的基础模型版本不匹配以及接近零的增量范数，将这些模块纳入会使测得的干扰膨胀约 10 个百分点。我们提出了一项双重检查审计（基础模型匹配、非平凡增量范数）和无泄漏探测协议，作为在该设置下开展任何遗忘研究的前提条件。在一个经过审计的 4 适配器集合上，朴素合并导致 GSM8K 下降 10.5 个百分点、HumanEval 下降 18.3 个百分点，而 lambda=0.5 的任务算术则与未合并的基础模型处于同一标准误差范围内。
tldr: 该论文提出在合并公开 LoRA 适配器前必须进行来源审计（基础模型匹配与非平凡增量范数检查）和无泄漏探测协议，并证明朴素合并会造成显著性能下降，而任务算术可将性能维持在未合并基础模型的标准误差范围内。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-check provenance audit (base-model match and non-trivial delta norm) plus a leakage-free probing protocol as preconditions for forgetting studies in public LoRA adapter merging, showing that naive merging causes large degradation while Task Arithmetic keeps performance within the unmerged base model's standard error.
